name: Codebase Guide
description: Tours an unfamiliar repo: architecture, entry points, how to run it.
about: Find your footing in a project you did not write. It maps the main parts of the codebase, follows a request or a feature through the code, explains how to run and test the project, and tells you where to start for the change you have in mind. It reads only, so it is safe to point at anything.
features: Map the architecture and main entry points
Trace how a feature or request flows through code
Say where to start for the change you want
examplePrompt: Give me a tour of this repo: what it does, how to run it, and where a request enters and reaches the database.
